annotations.title: asksteps: list the forms in the connected account

description: Lists the forms and funnels in the connected asksteps account, with their publication state. Requires the user to have connected their account and granted "forms:read". Use it to find the id of a form before asking for its statistics.
name: asksteps_list_forms

forms.description: The forms and funnels of the connected account with their publication state. Absent unless status is "ok".

note.description: One sentence for the user. Empty when there is nothing to say.

status.description: Outcome. One of: "ok", "not_connected", "error". Authorisation can also refuse before the tool runs: "plan_required" (the account's plan does not include agent access), "not_enabled" (the account owner has not switched agent access on), "owner_required" (only the account owner may do this), "mandate_required" (the owner has not granted a mandate for this). The note then says what the user has to do.

title: asksteps: list the forms in the connected account
